checks.sentence: 1. Customer concentration on Indian Railways. Indian Railways contributed 57% of revenue in Fiscal 2018, and Western Railway accounts for 52% of the orders on hand. Loss of this client — through contract cancellation, non-renewal, or a change in procurement policy — would cause a severe and immediate revenue drop.
checks.supporting_excerpt_quote: Majority of our revenues will be dependent on one customer, Indian Railways, which is our largest customer, contributing to 57% of our revenue in Fiscal 2018. ... Our Order Book with Western Railway being our major client contributing to 52% of the Orders on Hand

checks.sentence: 2. Revenue dependence on winning government tenders. The company's revenues rely entirely on being the lowest bidder in government tenders. If bids are not accepted or are negotiated to lower values, revenue would suffer. The company has no control over the volume or timing of tender awards.
checks.supporting_excerpt_quote: Our revenues largely depend on acceptance of the bids submitted to the Government and Government Departments. ... Job /Work is awarded to the lowest Quote

checks.sentence: 3. Geographical concentration in Mumbai. A major portion of revenue comes from operations in and around Mumbai. Any adverse development in that region — a natural disaster, a change in municipal policy, or a slowdown in local infrastructure spending — could disproportionately impact results.
checks.supporting_excerpt_quote: We generate major portion of our revenue from our operations in certain geographical regions especially Mumbai

checks.sentence: 4. Negative cash flows and high short-term debt. The company had negative cash flows in recent years and short-term borrowings of ₹3,537.35 lakhs as of FY2018, with unsecured loans of ₹405.02 lakhs repayable on demand. Sustained negative cash flow could harm operations, and a demand for repayment of unsecured loans could create a liquidity crisis.
checks.supporting_excerpt_quote: Our Company had negative cash flow in recent financial years ... Short Term Borrowings 3,537.35 ... availed ₹ 405.02 lakhs as unsecured loan ... repayable on demand.

checks.sentence: 5. Related-party transactions and struck-off promoter companies. The company has ongoing related-party transactions — loans, director remuneration, and outstanding payables of ₹324.3 lakhs. Two companies promoted by the promoter were struck off by the ROC for non-operation, raising governance concerns about the promoter's business practices.
checks.supporting_excerpt_quote: We have in the past entered into related party transactions ... Loan Taken 68.4 ... Director Remuneration 57.7 ... Payables 324.3 ... Two companies ... struck off by the Registrar of Companies (ROC) ... due to non-operation of business.

report.summary: The report is well-sourced. All specific claims are directly supported by the cited DRHP excerpts, except for one minor overstatement about the RMC plant supplying concrete for the company's own projects, which is implied but not explicitly stated in the cited page. No blocking issues found.
